description: The chart illustrates the relationship between the number of shots and the value of B, comparing "Incorrect" and "Correct" categories. The horizontal axis represents the "Number of Shots," labeled with integer values from 0 to 4, while the vertical axis is labeled "B" with a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 0.6 with an interval of 0.2. The chart features grouped bars, with each group containing two bars representing "Incorrect" (blue with black dots) and "Correct" (red with diagonal lines). The "Incorrect" bars have values of approximately 0.45, 0.5, 0.55, 0.6, and 0.65 for 0 to 4 shots, respectively, while the "Correct" bars have values of approximately 0.8, 0.85, 0.85, 0.8, and 0.7 for 0 to 4 shots, respectively. The bars are grouped by the number of shots, with the "Incorrect" bar positioned to the left of the "Correct" bar in each group. The chart does not display any specific sorting or visual emphasis on the bars.
